comparison.objective: Remove a glass pane with suction lifters and place it on bearers.
comparison.physical_skill: Attach two suction tools, cooperatively lift a fragile sheet, carry level, place and detach.
comparison.success_condition: Pane rests flat on both bearers with lifters unlocked and hands clear, without drop, excessive tilt or direct gripping.
comparison.reason: Shares bimanual load handling and careful placement, but has no agitation, selective passage or mixed-material separation.
